response_item.revised_prompt: Create one seamless, flat TOP-DOWN pavement albedo texture for the street in the ORIGINAL approved street-corner concept attached earlier (weathered grey stone pavement beside the low grey building and dark asphalt). This is a separate review-only material source, not a scene render and not a new benchmark. Square opaque image, seamless repeat on all four edges. Show a restrained 4 by 4 arrangement of large grey concrete/stone sidewalk slabs, subtle narrow charcoal joints aligned horizontally and vertically, with tile borders aligned so adjoining copies continue the slab grid. Slight irregular wear, broad low-contrast flaked patches and a few tiny cracks. Muted neutral grey with a very small warm undertone, not beige, tan or brown. Match the concept's subdued grey pavement, soft overcast illumination and hand-painted realistic material. NO diagonal/isometric perspective baked into the texture, NO building, curb, stairs, road, crossing, rails, manhole, leaves, grass, props, shadows, labels, letters, checkerboard background or transparent areas. No strong vignette, no directional cast lighting, no bright borders. Preserve subtle texture that reads as a calm continuous surface at game scale rather than a busy repetitive decorative plaza.
